name: Fiona Eustace
original_name: フィオナ・ユーステス
source:
Likes: Rumors, gaining information
Dislikes: Making people sad

A girl who constantly dubs herself the informant, she loves listening to gossip, sticking her nose into whatever catches her curiosity and sharing the information she has gathered with everyone else. As a result, she is very interested in [url=/c39583]Yuto[/url] as well and constantly keeps tabs on him. Fiona has a very casual personality and she talks.

She wants to make the people around her smile with the information she has gathered, and also help them, which is her main reason for doing it.
